welcomeTitle: Her AI answers you now. She answers in person when you ask.
welcomeBody: Every message says who wrote it: Maya's AI, Maya herself, or her team. You'll always know which.
pantopusAccount: One Pantopus account signs you in to every Pantopus app. New here? You'll create it in the next step.
identityStrip: You're talking to {name}'s AI · {name} steps in on request.
officialDisclaimer: Official means {name} authorized this AI. It does not mean she read your message.
conversationAccess: Conversations with a creator's AI can be read by that creator and their authorized team. Those accesses are logged. You can delete any conversation at any time.
packetAccess: {name} and her authorized team can separately review this AI conversation. Those accesses are logged.
chargeRule: Charged only when {name} accepts. If she declines or {deadline} pass, nothing is charged.
pendingHold: Your bank may show a pending hold for a few days.
draftNotice: {name} may answer with her AI's draft; you'll see that label.
capacity: {name} answers {mode} within {deadline} · {n} of {cap} left this week.
auditAccess: Opening this conversation is logged and visible to the fan.
longSession: You've been talking with {name}'s AI for a while. It's an AI, and it will be here when you're back.
noteReplies: Only {name} and her team see replies to Notes.
processorConsent: Before your first message, {name}'s AI is powered by {providers}. They don't keep or train on your messages.
sensitiveMemory: Want me to remember this? Only if you say yes.
spendLimit: Set a monthly limit. You can change it any time; raising it takes 24 hours.
handback: {name} left the conversation · you're back with {name}'s AI
declined: {name} passed on this one · nothing charged
expired: {name}'s queue didn't get to this · nothing charged
paymentFailed: Payment didn't go through · nothing was shared
aiPaused: {name}'s AI is paused · requests still work
removeContext: Remove this post from your first message
pantopusUnavailable: Pantopus sign-in is not connected in this local build.

exactSignature: Face ID signs exactly this. Any change needs a new signature.
insteadExplanation: None of these charge the fan. Some need the fan's acceptance first.
publishingWait: Publishing waits until every test passes · failing: {tests}
publishingReady: Every test passes. Publishing makes this version live for every fan.
digestFiled: Filed as a test case · every future version is checked against it
emailFooter: You get this email because you asked {name} to step in. Manage email for each creator, set quiet hours or hide sensitive previews in You › Notifications.
teamStripRest: · they reply as her team, never as {name}
fullyBooked: {name} is fully booked this week · opens Monday
aiPausedBack: {name}'s AI is paused · back {date} · requests still work
endCan: read this conversation and ask {name} to step in.
endIncluded: your free first conversation, now complete.
endChanges: Kiln Club includes {name}'s AI, her Notes and the right to ask for her.
accessDefaultRequest: a written reply, a voice note, a call · priced by {name}, charged only if she accepts.
accessDefaultChanges: your Kiln Club membership renews Oct 14.
monthlyLimitLegend: Monthly limit for requests and memberships
limitReminders: Reminders at 50% and 100% of your limit are on. Lowering a limit is immediate.
insteadAIHelp: No charge. The request closes and your AI answers under its own label.
insteadGroupHelp: Offer it at your group price. The fan accepts or keeps waiting.
insteadInfoHelp: The fan replies in the request. Your deadline pauses; the card hold's does not.
insteadDeclineHelp: Add a one-tap reason if you like. It never counts against you.
